title.narrative: Life-saving emergency livelihood support to vulnerable food insecure farming households in the conflict and flood affected state of Kayin - Myanmar

description.narrative: The main objective of this FAO project is to provide Life-saving emergency livelihood support to vulnerable food insecure farming households in the conflict and flood affected state of Kayin - Myanmar. Under this project, FAO focuses on providing time-critical agricultural inputs in the form of paddy seeds and compound fertilizer, provides cash grants to vulnerable farming households, and conducts awareness orientation during distributions on appropriate cultivation techniques for certified seeds/improved varieties, integrated nutrient and pest management, and nutrition. This project provides life-saving assistance to 11,550 people, of whom 3,465 women, 3,233 men and 4,852 children. An estimated 809 people with disabilities benefit from this project.
